summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated bundled payload via Bun
details: package.json declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs (identifiers renamed to `_0x...`, indicating obfuscation) downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub release archive, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and then executes the bundled `math_init.js` under that freshly-dropped runtime via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {stdio:'inherit'})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` that uses string-array-rotation obfuscation (rotator function shifts a >1000-entry mixed hex/string constant array on each lookup, decoded via a helper function) — its actual behavior is intentionally hidden. A Vue chat client has no legitimate reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime at install time to run an opaque bundle unrelated to its advertised purpose; the alternate-runtime step evades Node-based scanners, and the payload executes automatically on `npm install`, handing full-host code execution to whatever `math_init.js` implements.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
